ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $PA$ and $PB$ are tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at points $A$ and $B$, respectively. Point $C$ is a point on the circle $\odot O$. Connect $AC$ and $BC$. If $\angle P = 80^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle ACB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $OA$ and $OB$.\\
Since $PA$ and $PB$ are tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at points A and B, respectively,\\
it follows that $OA\perp PA$ and $OB\perp PB$,\\
which means $\angle OAP=\angle OBP=90^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOB=180^\circ-\angle P=180^\circ-80^\circ=100^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle ACB=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=\frac{1}{2}\times 100^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
